fee_notes: Single franchise fee is $39,500 per salon for new franchisees. Existing Cost Cutters franchisees (single salon) prior to September 30, 2011 pay $12,500. Fast Start Program (multi-salon development) charges $69,500 for 3-salon and $99,500 for 6-salon development rights, with $10,000 per additional salon beyond 6. Under the Fast Start Program, no separate initial franchise fee is charged per salon; the development fee covers all rights. During the last fiscal year, development fees ranged from $0 to $39,500. Fees are generally non-refundable, though Cost Cutters may refund the initial fee (less expenses) if a franchisee fails training or provided materially false information.
